routeReason: The same transparent finish layout is generated for levels 04–12 and affects reward readability at the core settlement moment.

evidence.scope: 9 levels share the same overlap pattern; Level 04 has direct screenshot evidence, while the other levels require viewport-specific perceptual retest.
